name: MDPEP
summary: MDPEP (also known as MD-PV8 and MDPHPP) is a substituted cathinone derivative with stimulant effects which has been sold as a designer drug. It is the longer chain heptyl homologue of the well known stimulant designer drugs MDPV and MDPHP.

summaryZh: MDPEP，也稱為MD-PV8、MDPHPP，化學名：1-[3,4-(亞甲二氧基)苯基]-2-(N-吡咯烷基)-1-庚酮，是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C18H25NO3，屬於卡西酮衍生物，與MDPV、MDPHP是同系物，2019年首次在瑞典的黑市上發現。
